stops.name: Monte Canin
stops.quote: Le cime principali sono il Monte Canin (2.587 m), il Monte Plauris (1.958 m), la catena dei Monti Musi (1.869 m).
stops.english: The main peaks are Monte Canin (2,587 m), Monte Plauris (1,958 m), and the Monti Musi chain (1,869 m).

stops.name: Prato
stops.quote: La sede del parco si trova nella frazione Prato del comune di Resia.
stops.english: The park headquarters are located in the hamlet of Prato in the municipality of Resia.

stops.name: ricovero alpino Rio Nero Casera
stops.quote: Nel parco naturale sono presenti i seguenti rifugi: ricovero alpino Rio Nero Casera a 865 m s.l.m.; ricovero alpino Borgo Miniera a 966 m s.l.m.; ricovero alpino Marsinska Planina a 1401 m s.l.m.; ricovero alpino Montemaggiore-Gran Monte a 1648 m s.l.m.; ricovero alpino Bellina Dino a 1405 m s.l.m..
stops.english: The following refuges are present in the natural park: Rio Nero Casera alpine shelter at 865 m above sea level; Borgo Miniera alpine shelter at 966 m above sea level; Marsinska Planina alpine shelter at 1401 m above sea level; Montemaggiore-Gran Monte alpine shelter at 1648 m above sea level; Bellina Dino alpine shelter at 1405 m above sea level.

stops.name: Val Resia
stops.quote: In Val Resia, sul torrione Mulaz 1804, parete NNE, il 18 ottobre 2013 è stata attrezzata la L. Ron Hubbard Route - Mulaz Climbing Route.
stops.english: In Val Resia, on the Mulaz 1804 tower, NNE face, the L. Ron Hubbard Route - Mulaz Climbing Route was equipped on October 18, 2013.

stops.name: bivacco Franco Costantini - CAI Manzano
